summary: Implemented all 6 phases of the caller-side phase-commit completeness check. Added git-commit-phase.sh (derives the stage list from files_touched, mechanizes the containment self-check, invokes git-commit-scoped.sh unpiped, and fails loudly at exit 6 when a derived path is not clean against HEAD after the commit); its 16-assertion fixture suite; migrated both phase-commit call sites in general-implementation-agent.md; added a piped-invocation lint rule to lint-scoped-commit-boundary.sh wired into verify-deploy gate 17; and corrected three durable records (Verification repo's issues.jsonl, git-staging-scope.md's ten-vs-nine Typst miscount, and task 374's inverted commit-provenance issue-log entry). Redeployed and ran the full gate set: verify-deploy.sh 34/35 gates pass; the one failing gate (tests/run-all.sh) has exactly 3 pre-existing, unrelated failures with no connection to this task's file_scope, closed via a full Reasoned Exclusions record on Phase 6 (COMPLETED WITH EXCLUSIONS).
